name: Adam Smith
intro: Connect support, product, and engineering to turn merchant signals into fixes and features.

roles.title: Product Support Specialist
paragraphs: Connect support, product, and engineering to turn merchant signals into fixes and features.
bullets: Tier 3 technical support - last line for support. File GitHub issues with repro steps, logs, and severity. Coordinate incident response for broad-impact events.
Partnered with sales, technical, and product on QuickBooks integrations - contributed to onboarding 18,000+ merchants and $60M in 2024 revenue.
Product Owner for Retail Products. Bridged technical, support, and sales. Reduced documentation update cycle time 57% (from 70+ days to 30) and improved clarity for teams.
Built business case for Monosap’s migration from Google Cloud to AWS - delivered a 10% hosting cost reduction and enabled support optimizations that reduced support debt by 2%.
Led knowledge management overhaul. Decentralized ownership so departments manage updates. Sustained 95%+ accuracy.
Established support protocols for the Shopify Supply Store. Integrated customer feedback and third party platform transitions. Cut delivery times by 20 days and reduced support debt by 50%.

roles.title: Support Mentor
paragraphs: Mentored new hires, returning staff, and BPO agents. Training on platform navigation, resource discovery, and tool usage to help merchants grow.
Impact: Contributed 20+ resources to the knowledge base focused on workflow optimization and merchant growth. Q2 2023 cohort earned QA scores 5% above the average graduate.

roles.title: Core Support Advisor
paragraphs: Supported U.S. East merchants. Analyzed processes and implemented solutions to meet ecommerce goals.

Impact: Resolved 16-20 cases daily with 90%+ satisfaction. 7% above company average. Channeled merchant feedback into 300+ product launches. Increased resource adoption 23% with a new allocation system.

roles.title: Junior Support Advisor
paragraphs: Supported international and small merchants as they launched, developed, and expanded their businesses.
Impact: Completed three contracts while meeting ticket quotas and KPIs. Finished projects ahead of schedule while mastering the Shopify platform.

roles.title: Founder
paragraphs: Designed and built VersaStrength One: A mobile fitness device for full-body home workouts - informed by market research on accessibility and efficiency.
Accepted into the ElevateIP Spring 2024 cohort with Intellectual Property Ontario (IPON) after proof of concept. Secured grants for patent applications.

roles.title: Customer Development
paragraphs: Provided and managed Azure cloud services for small businesses. Guided product selection, deployment, and support.
bullets: Led user research to align products with business needs, increased customer retention by 15 points from 72% to 87%, lifted sales efficiency 20%, contributed $312K in incremental 2019 revenue.
Developed three product roadmaps in 2018, increased new client signups 10% from 2,100 to 2,310, produced a $248K sales uplift.
Onboarded more than 105 businesses to Azure Cloud Services in 2020, generated $482K in sales through needs assessment and service optimization.
Led infrastructure delivery for the top eight clients, reduced time to market 25%, added $210K in annual sales.

roles.title: Administrator - Manager
paragraphs: Optimized sales team performance to drive growth and revenue.
bullets: Led ongoing sales training. Increased new client sign-ups to 104 in 2017 from 82 in 2016 - supported 10% yearly portfolio growth.
Coordinated with fund managers at Fidelity, HSBC, and RBC - summarized strategies into a sales knowledge base. Reduced sales support queries 27% (2,300 in 2013 to 1,680 in 2016).
Aligned Legal, Sales, and Compliance to author workflow documentation. Increased client signup rates 5%.
Authored 103 knowledge documents for a 12-person sales team. Supported a 4% revenue increase from $5.2M in Q1 2017 to $5.4M in Q4 2018.
Met quarterly and annual commission targets - $289K in 2017 and $312K in 2018.

roles.title: Regional Manager
paragraphs: Improved operational performance across corporate and franchise locations by managing to established KPIs.

Impact: Increased staff retention 20%. Raised stakeholder satisfaction 15%. Reduced supply costs 15%. Signed 3 dealerships and 10 body shops - lifted sales 25%. Managed the top-revenue corporate location and supported franchise scale to 1K units - contributed to 35% revenue growth.
